claim: 97% of llms.txt files never get read (~38,000 valid files of 137K domains)

primary_source.name: Ahrefs — We Analyzed 137K Sites: 97% of llms.txt Files Never Get Read

snapshot.excerpt: Ahrefs (Louise Linehan, 2026-06-15): using Ahrefs Web Analytics and Bot Analytics, we analyzed the server logs and live traffic of 137K domains, plus the user agents hitting all of them. 28% of the 137K domains publish an llms.txt file (~38,000). 97% of those files received zero traffic in May 2026. 96% of requests that reached llms.txt files came from bots; 19.5% of fetches came from named AI tools.

replayability: partial (method described; raw logs not published)
